rows.label: PSU / Government
rows.why: Permanent government and PSU staff are almost never laid off; the risk is hiring freezes and posts left vacant (8.24 lakh central posts vacant), not job loss. Contract and outsourced staff are not protected the same way.
rows.advice: If you're on contract or outsourced, check your agency's renewal terms; permanent staff should track departmental restructuring and transfer policies.

rows.label: Small (<500)
rows.why: Nearly 9 in 10 shutdowns tracked on this site were startups, often with no notice or severance.
rows.advice: Keep 6+ months of expenses saved and watch funding news; check runway if you can.

rows.label: Mid (500–5,000)
rows.why: Mid-size firms restructure in rounds of 10–30% (Porter, Gupshup, Livspace) but rarely shut down overnight.
rows.advice: Watch for re-orgs and merged teams; stay visible on core products.

rows.label: Large (5,000–50,000)
rows.why: Large firms cut in waves tied to results and AI programmes (Freshworks, PayPal India, Visa) but usually pay severance.
rows.advice: Stay on growth or AI-linked teams; legacy product teams are cut first.

rows.label: Enterprise (50,000+)
rows.why: The biggest single cuts tracked here came from the largest employers: TCS, Cognizant, Oracle, Infosys and Wipro.
rows.advice: Watch quarterly headcount and bench policy; avoid long stints on the bench.

rows.label: Less than 1 year
rows.why: New joiners and trainees are exposed: Infosys let go of trainees after failed assessments, and probation exits need no formal layoff.
rows.advice: Clear probation milestones early and get feedback in writing.

rows.label: 1–2 years
rows.why: Still early enough to be cut in 'last in, first out' rounds.
rows.advice: Build visible ownership of one important project.

rows.label: 2–4 years
rows.why: Established but not yet expensive; usually the most protected tenure band.
rows.advice: Keep your skills current; this is the best time to switch if your team looks weak.

rows.label: 5+ years
rows.why: Long tenure protects you unless your salary is high relative to your role (Dr. Reddy's reportedly targeted ₹1 crore+ packages).
rows.advice: Make sure your pay is matched by current, in-demand skills.

rows.label: Junior (0–3 yrs)
rows.why: Fresher postings grew only 1% YoY (Naukri), below the market, and companies are hiring fewer entry-level staff as AI takes routine work.
rows.advice: Get one demonstrable, in-demand skill (AI, cloud, data) and a portfolio, not just certificates.

rows.label: Mid-level (3–7 yrs)
rows.why: The largest group in most companies; exposure depends on role and skill more than level.
rows.advice: Specialise and lead small projects to move up.

rows.label: Senior (7–12 yrs)
rows.why: Postings for 13–15 years' experience grew 7% and ₹20 LPA+ roles 23% (Naukri): senior specialists are in demand.
rows.advice: Stay hands-on with current tools; senior people who stop building are vulnerable.

rows.label: Lead / Manager
rows.why: Middle-management layers are being thinned, but managers who own delivery are retained.
rows.advice: Own outcomes, not just people; keep technical credibility.

rows.label: Executive / C-suite
rows.why: Few in number and often protected, but exits follow mergers and leadership changes (e.g. after the JioStar merger).
rows.advice: Keep your network active; leadership exits are rarely announced as layoffs.

rows.label: Artisan / craft worker (cutting, polishing, tailoring)
rows.why: Hit hardest by the 2025 US tariffs: the diamond workers' union claims ~1 lakh jobs lost in Saurashtra and Tiruppur exporters cut ~2,850 in one month.
rows.advice: Look for units serving domestic or non-US export markets; learn machine or CAD-based work that pays more and is harder to replace.

rows.label: Shop-floor operator / technician
rows.why: Exposed to demand slowdowns and plant automation; Volkswagen India is cutting 12% of staff by 2027, including shop-floor roles.
rows.advice: Get certified on the automated equipment your plant is installing (CNC, robotics, PLC).

rows.label: Maintenance / plant engineering
rows.why: Plants still need people to keep automated lines running; cut less often than operators.
rows.advice: Add automation, PLC and predictive-maintenance skills.

rows.label: Quality control / QA
rows.why: Steady demand, especially in export and regulated units, but vision systems are automating inspection.
rows.advice: Learn quality systems (ISO, Six Sigma) and inspection tech.

rows.label: Supply chain / procurement
rows.why: Tariffs and supplier shifts are increasing demand for sourcing skills, though routine purchasing is automating.
rows.advice: Build skills in vendor diversification, trade compliance and ERP analytics.

rows.label: R&D / design engineering
rows.why: Product and process design work is growing with semiconductor and EV investment.
rows.advice: Stay close to new product programmes; add simulation and CAD tools.

rows.label: Branch / teller / back-office processing
rows.why: Large private banks' headcount fell in FY26 (ICICI −5,148, HDFC −3,343, Axis −3,100), mostly in non-supervisory roles, as digital banking grows.
rows.advice: Move toward sales, credit or customer-relationship roles inside the bank.

rows.label: Relationship manager / wealth advisory
rows.why: Customer-facing advisory roles are growing with retail investing; TeamLease puts banking hiring intent at +9.2%.
rows.advice: Get certified (NISM, CFP) and build a client book.

rows.label: Credit / risk / compliance
rows.why: BFSI added 15,000–20,000 operations roles in the past year, with risk and compliance in demand as regulation tightens.
rows.advice: Keep regulatory knowledge current (RBI, SEBI rules).

rows.label: Collections / field sales
rows.why: High churn and target pressure; digital collections and AI calling are reducing field teams.
rows.advice: Move toward roles with a long-term client book.

rows.label: Doctor
rows.why: India has 13.9 lakh registered allopathic doctors for 140 crore people; demand outstrips supply despite more medical seats.
rows.advice: Specialisation and procedures stay in demand; private-practice income depends on location.

rows.label: Nurse / allied health
rows.why: Shortage roles in India and abroad; hospital job postings dipped only slightly (−3% YoY, Naukri).
rows.advice: Specialised certifications (ICU, OT, dialysis) and overseas licences raise options.

rows.label: Medical coding / billing / RCM
rows.why: Outsourced US healthcare back-office work is being automated: CorroHealth shut its Kerala centres (~900 jobs).
rows.advice: Move toward clinical documentation audit, payer analytics or compliance roles.

rows.label: Medical rep / pharma sales
rows.why: Drugmakers are trimming field forces and moving to digital doctor outreach; pharma postings −4% YoY (Naukri).
rows.advice: Learn digital engagement tools and therapy-area depth.

rows.label: Lab / R&D / regulatory affairs
rows.why: Steady demand from CDMOs and regulatory work, though some R&D units are being consolidated.
rows.advice: Regulatory affairs and quality compliance are the safest niches.

rows.label: Store / dark-store staff
rows.why: Large workforce with high churn; quick-commerce expansion adds jobs, but stores close when units don't make money (Zepto Cafe, Satvacart).
rows.advice: Move to supervisor or inventory roles.

rows.label: Delivery / last-mile
rows.why: Festive hiring rose 7% (foundit), but this is mostly gig work with no job security.
rows.advice: Register on e-Shram for social-security benefits; diversify across platforms.

rows.label: Field sales / distribution (FMCG)
rows.why: HUL and Dabur cut permanent headcount ~11% each in FY26; FMCG postings −4% YoY (Naukri).
rows.advice: Learn modern-trade and e-commerce channel management.

rows.label: Category / merchandising
rows.why: Growing with e-commerce and quick commerce, though pricing and assortment tools are automating parts of it.
rows.advice: Pair category skills with data analysis.

rows.label: Voice / chat support agent
rows.why: Non-banking BPO hiring fell 40–50%, and AI voice agents are replacing scripted support (Opendoor's India team, Zomato's support centre).
rows.advice: Move to complex escalations, BFSI processes or AI-agent quality roles.

rows.label: BPO team lead / quality / workforce management
rows.why: Fewer agents means fewer supervisors, but AI-agent oversight creates new quality roles.
rows.advice: Learn to manage hybrid human-AI support teams.

rows.label: Network / field technician
rows.why: Nokia India is reportedly cutting up to 20%, but 5G and fibre rollouts still need field engineers.
rows.advice: Add 5G, fibre and cloud-networking skills.

rows.label: Journalist / editor / producer
rows.why: Media layoffs in 2025–26 (JioStar ~1,100, TV Today ~120, Technicolor India shutdown) and AI-generated content are shrinking newsrooms.
rows.advice: Specialise in investigative, video or subscription-driven content.

rows.label: VFX / animation / post-production
rows.why: Technicolor India's shutdown cost 3,370+ jobs; AI tools are cutting routine post-production work.
rows.advice: Move to real-time engines (Unreal) and AI-assisted pipelines.

rows.label: Front office / cabin crew / hotel staff
rows.why: Travel and hospitality hiring intent is +12.3% (TeamLease), but airline cuts happen when carriers struggle (SpiceJet 500+).
rows.advice: Choose financially stable employers; multilingual and service skills travel well.

rows.label: Warehouse / driver / dispatch
rows.why: Logistics firms cut in rounds (Ecom Express ~500, Porter 350, BluSmart shutdown) but festive and e-commerce demand keeps hiring up.
rows.advice: Get forklift, WMS or EV-fleet certifications.

rows.label: Teacher / faculty
rows.why: India has over 1 crore teachers; government hiring continues (Bihar 44,000), but private teaching and training postings fell 18% (Naukri).
rows.advice: Government and school roles are steadier than edtech; add digital-classroom skills.

rows.label: Academic counsellor / admissions sales
rows.why: Edtech sales teams were the first cut in the edtech downturn (Adda247 20%, Interview Kickstart).
rows.advice: Move to school/college admissions or B2B ed sales.

rows.label: Clerical / administrative staff
rows.why: Permanent posts are protected, but many clerical posts are left vacant and work is being digitised.
rows.advice: Prepare for departmental exams for promotion.

rows.label: Technical / engineering cadre
rows.why: Railways, defence and infrastructure still recruit technical staff (RRB Group D, JE).
rows.advice: Keep up with modernisation projects in your department.

rows.label: Officer cadre (Group A/B)
rows.why: Very low layoff risk; promotion and posting are the main uncertainties.
rows.advice: Track transfer and promotion policies.

rows.label: Contract / outsourced staff
rows.why: Not protected like permanent staff; contracts end when budgets or agencies change.
rows.advice: Prepare for regular-cadre exams (SSC, state PSC) while working.

rows.label: Software / Engineering
rows.why: IT services postings are down 4% and IT majors cut headcount, but AI, cloud and GCC engineering hiring is growing; risk depends heavily on your skill area.
rows.advice: Move from maintenance work to building with AI, cloud and platform engineering; GCCs are hiring where IT services are cutting.

rows.label: Data / Analytics
rows.why: AI/ML and data roles are the fastest-growing family on Naukri (+20% YoY), and two in three new GCC roles need AI or data skills.
rows.advice: Keep going deeper: ML engineering, data engineering and domain-specific analytics are in demand.

rows.label: Design / Creative
rows.why: Generative tools cut demand for production design, while product and UX design hold up better.
rows.advice: Shift toward product/UX design and design systems; show measurable outcomes.

rows.label: Content / Writing
rows.why: Bulk content, translation and SEO writing are among the tasks generative AI does fastest; media layoffs this year cut content teams.
rows.advice: Specialise: investigative, regulated (legal, medical, financial) or video/audio content where judgment and accountability matter.

rows.label: Operations / Support
rows.why: Support and back-office work is where AI and offshoring cuts land first: Zomato closed its Hyderabad support centre, Opendoor shut its India operations team.
rows.advice: Move from handling tickets to owning the tools: run, train and quality-check AI agents.

rows.label: Sales / BD
rows.why: Sales stays in demand (TeamLease: 64% of employers expanding sales & marketing hiring), but performance-linked exits are common.
rows.advice: Keep a documented pipeline and quota record; B2B sales are more resilient than tele-sales.

rows.label: Marketing
rows.why: Marketing budgets are cut early in downturns (Ogilvy India cuts on lower client spend); AI-assisted marketing is replacing some roles.
rows.advice: Prove revenue impact with numbers; learn marketing automation and analytics.

rows.label: HR / Recruiting
rows.why: Recruiting teams shrink first when hiring slows, and HR operations are being automated.
rows.advice: Build skills in workforce analytics, HR tech and compliance (labour codes).

rows.label: Finance / Accounts
rows.why: Accounting/finance postings are flat (+0.6% YoY, Naukri) while routine bookkeeping automates.
rows.advice: Move toward analysis, controllership, tax and compliance (GST, IFRS).

rows.label: Senior Management
rows.why: Companies are flattening layers (Cognizant's 'shorter pyramid', TCS's mid- and senior-level cuts), but leaders with P&L ownership are retained.
rows.advice: Tie your role to revenue or cost outcomes; avoid pure coordination roles.

rows.label: AI / ML / GenAI
rows.why: AI/ML postings +20% YoY on Naukri; 55% of Indeed job categories now mention AI; two in three new GCC roles need AI or data skills.
rows.advice: Keep shipping real projects; depth in one domain plus AI is worth more than generic AI skills.

rows.label: Cloud / DevOps / security
rows.why: Cloud, cybersecurity and platform engineering are top GCC hiring priorities after AI.
rows.advice: Production experience matters more than certifications.

rows.label: Full stack / app development
rows.why: Still in demand, but AI coding tools reduce the number of developers needed for routine features.
rows.advice: Pair it with AI tooling, system design or a domain.

rows.label: Product management
rows.why: Product roles are cut when companies narrow focus (Innovaccer, Freshworks restructured around fewer products).
rows.advice: Own a product line with clear revenue or usage metrics.

rows.label: Legacy systems / maintenance
rows.why: IT services postings fell 4% and IT majors cut headcount as clients move from staffing-heavy maintenance to automated delivery.
rows.advice: Move to modernisation work: migration, cloud, AI-assisted maintenance.
rows.applies: group:Technology,group:Startups & Internet,sector:Fintech & Payments,sector:E-commerce & Retail,sector:Quick Commerce & Food Delivery,sector:Healthcare & Healthtech,sector:Banking & Financial Services,sector:Telecom,sector:BPO & Customer Operations

rows.label: Automation / robotics / PLC
rows.why: Plants are automating; the people who run and fix the machines are the ones being hired.
rows.advice: Add vendor certifications for the systems your plant uses.

rows.label: Machine / CNC operation
rows.why: Steady demand, but output per operator is rising with automation.
rows.advice: Learn programming, not just operating, the machines.

rows.label: Manual assembly / handwork
rows.why: Export-linked handwork (garments, diamond polishing) lost the most jobs after the 2025 US tariffs.
rows.advice: Learn machine-assisted or CAD-based methods; look at domestic-market units.

rows.label: Quality, safety & compliance
rows.why: Export buyers and regulators demand more certification, keeping these skills valued.
rows.advice: Get ISO, BIS or export-compliance certification.

rows.label: Supply chain / ERP / planning
rows.why: Tariff-driven supplier shifts raise demand for planners and sourcing analysts.
rows.advice: Learn SAP/ERP modules and demand-planning tools.

rows.label: Credit, risk & regulatory
rows.why: Risk and compliance roles are in demand as BFSI operations hiring grows (15,000–20,000 roles).
rows.advice: Keep certifications current (FRM, NISM, IRDAI).

rows.label: Wealth / investment advisory
rows.why: Rising retail investing supports advisory demand.
rows.advice: Get NISM/CFP certification and a client base.

rows.label: Branch operations / cash handling
rows.why: Digital payments are shrinking branch work; private banks cut non-supervisory headcount in FY26.
rows.advice: Move to credit, sales or digital banking roles.

rows.label: Clinical (medicine, nursing)
rows.why: Clinical skills are scarce relative to population; hospital postings dipped only slightly.
rows.advice: Specialise and keep licences current.

rows.label: Diagnostics / lab technology
rows.why: Diagnostics chains keep expanding, though lab automation reduces manual testing.
rows.advice: Learn automated analysers and quality systems.

rows.label: Medical coding / billing
rows.why: Offshore US healthcare back-office work is being automated (CorroHealth ~900 jobs).
rows.advice: Move to audit, compliance or analytics roles.

rows.label: Digital commerce / marketplaces
rows.why: E-commerce and quick commerce lead hiring intent (+12.6%, TeamLease) and festive hiring.
rows.advice: Learn marketplace ads, catalog and analytics tools.

rows.label: Traditional field / distributor sales
rows.why: FMCG permanent headcount fell at HUL and Dabur as distribution goes digital.
rows.advice: Learn retailer apps and modern-trade channels.

rows.label: Voice process / scripted support
rows.why: Scripted voice and chat work is the most exposed to AI agents; non-banking BPO hiring fell 40–50%.
rows.advice: Move to complex, regulated or multilingual processes.

rows.label: Complex escalations / domain processes
rows.why: Judgment-heavy processes (insurance claims, banking operations) are still growing.
rows.advice: Pick a regulated domain and certify in it.

rows.label: 5G / fibre / network engineering
rows.why: Network rollouts continue even as vendors restructure.
rows.advice: Add cloud-networking and automation skills.

rows.label: Video / digital production
rows.why: Digital video and streaming keep growing while print and linear TV shrink.
rows.advice: Learn AI-assisted editing and short-form formats.

rows.label: Print / linear TV / legacy media
rows.why: Readership and ad money keep moving from print and TV to digital.
rows.advice: Move your beat or skills to digital formats.

rows.label: Guest service / languages
rows.why: Travel demand is strong and service skills are hard to automate.
rows.advice: Add languages and premium-service certifications.

rows.label: Driving / warehouse / fleet ops
rows.why: Demand is high but mostly gig or contract, with automation in large warehouses.
rows.advice: Get EV or warehouse-system certifications.

rows.label: Subject teaching
rows.why: Over 1 crore teachers and large state recruitment drives (Bihar 44,000 teachers), though private teaching postings fell 18%.
rows.advice: Clear eligibility tests (TET/CTET) for government and school roles.

rows.label: Exam-prep coaching
rows.why: Online test-prep is consolidating (Adda247 cut 20% before its IPO); offline coaching is steadier.
rows.advice: Build a personal brand or move to established offline institutes.

rows.label: Instructional design / ed-tech tools
rows.why: Schools and companies need people who can build digital and AI-assisted courses.
rows.advice: Learn LMS platforms and AI course-authoring tools.

rows.label: General administration
rows.why: Permanent government administrative roles are rarely cut, though digitisation reduces new posts.
rows.advice: Learn e-office and digital governance tools.

rows.label: Technical / engineering
rows.why: Railways, defence and infrastructure keep recruiting technical staff.
rows.advice: Track departmental modernisation projects.

rows.label: Uses AI / digital tools daily
rows.why: More than half of job categories now mention AI (Indeed); people who use these tools are favoured over those who don't.
rows.advice: Keep adding tools that save measurable time in your work.

rows.label: Domain expertise (non-tech)
rows.why: Domain knowledge protects you when combined with tools; on its own it is exposed in restructuring.
rows.advice: Learn the data and AI tools used in your domain.

rows.label: People management
rows.why: Middle layers are being thinned, but managers who own outcomes are retained.
rows.advice: Own measurable results, not just headcount.

rows.label: Manual / repetitive tasks
rows.why: About half of the announced job cuts tracked here cite AI or automation, and routine processing roles were cut first.
rows.advice: Upskill into supervising automated workflows, or move to roles that need judgment and customer contact.
